# 9 AI Coworker Platforms for Business Teams in 2026
[![Mahmoud Mabrouk](https://agenta.ai/authors/mahmoud-mabrouk.webp)](https://agenta.ai/authors/mahmoud-mabrouk)

Choose Agenta when a team needs configurable, shared autonomous coworkers with model and deployment control.

## AI coworker platforms compared
### Agenta: best for configurable AI coworkers a team can share and self-host
[Agenta](https://agenta.ai/) is an open-source workspace for building AI coworkers and automations for professional work. Instead of one general assistant, a team can create several coworkers with distinct jobs, each with its own instructions, files, skills, tools, channels, permissions, and schedules. It is built to stay simple for the person asking for work without hiding the machinery from the person who operates it. A business user can request work, give feedback, and reuse the coworker. A technical teammate can inspect the configuration, connect systems, set permissions, trace runs, and review costs.

For the weekly competitor brief, the team can create a named researcher, connect its sources and publishing tools, define the review step, schedule the run, and share the same coworker with colleagues. Model and payment freedom are central. A team can bring its own model-provider keys, use supported ChatGPT or Claude subscriptions, or connect supported free and lower-cost models when self-hosted. Feedback updates the coworker, and versioning keeps the improved behavior without losing the previous setup.

This flexibility asks more at the start than a fixed assistant. A technical founder or teammate will usually set up the advanced integrations, permissions, and deployment, and the benefits are clearest for ongoing work rather than a single quick task.

![An Agenta coworker’s configuration, with model, instructions, integrations, subagents, and triggers, next to a working session.](https://agenta.ai/blog/ai-coworker-platforms-for-business/agenta.webp)

_An Agenta coworker in use: its configuration (model, instructions, integrations, subagents, and triggers) sits beside the session where the team works with it._

**Useful capabilities**

- Several coworkers with distinct jobs, each with its own instructions, files, skills, tools, channels, permissions, and schedules
- Private and shared conversations for team use
- Feedback-driven improvement with visible, versioned configuration
- Bring-your-own-key plus supported ChatGPT and Claude subscription access when self-hosted
- Model choice, gateways, self-hosted models, tracing, token use, and estimated cost
- Cloud and [self-hosted deployment](https://agenta.ai/docs/self-host/quick-start)
- Scheduled runs and [application events](https://agenta.ai/docs/self-host/app-tools-and-triggers)
- Open-source, MIT-licensed platform with portable agent components

## How to choose and deploy AI coworkers
### Which AI coworker platform should you choose?
- Choose **Agenta** when the team wants configurable coworkers it can share, version, inspect, and run with its chosen models or infrastructure.

### Frequently asked questions
An AI coworker is an agent configured around an ongoing responsibility, with reusable context, tools, boundaries, review, and a way to improve future work.

Agenta, Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Workspace Agents, Dust, Relevance AI, Lindy, Zapier, and n8n support scheduled work in some form.

## Give your team its first AI coworker
Give the coworker the tools and context it needs, review its first result, and save your corrections for the next run.

[Build your first coworker](https://cloud.agenta.ai/) [Self-host Agenta](https://agenta.ai/docs/self-host/quick-start)
